ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human raids, mechanoid raids, manhunter packs, and mech cluster defenders with fewer, stronger vanilla or official-DLC pawn kinds while preserving each threat's tactical roles and special mechanics. Mechanoid raids are now classified as homogeneous swarms, mixed forces, breach forces, or boss-led forces before future arrival-aware wave handling is allowed. Mech cluster buildings and activation rules remain untouched. An in-game audit page shows every before/after composition, tactical-identity proof, classification, and safe fallback. It does not add hidden combat stat buffs.
通过使用派系原本拥有的高阶人类兵种、机械体型号或战术特征相近的官方动物，减少后期人类、机械体、食人动物和机械集群防卫单位的数量，同时保留每类袭击原有的职责与特殊机制。机械袭击会先区分单一机械海、混编、破墙和头目带队，只有安全类别才可进入后续的分批增援阶段。机械集群建筑和唤醒规则完全不变；不添加隐藏战斗属性 Buff。
